description: This file defines the class 'SeoUrl' within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for managing SEO URL records including adding, editing, deleting, retrieving, and filtering SEO URLs in the database.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Model class for managing SEO URL records in the OpenCart admin module, providing methods for CRUD operations and querying SEO URLs based on various filters.

methods.name: addSeoUrl
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO URL record into the database with specified parameters and returns the ID of the newly created record.

methods.name: editSeoUrl
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO URL record identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrl
methods.description: Deletes a SEO URL record by its ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Deletes SEO URL records matching a specific key and value, with optional store and language filters.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: deleteSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all SEO URL records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record by its ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves a SEO URL record by key and value, with optional store and language filters.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Fetches a SEO URL record matching a specific keyword, store ID, and optional language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrls
methods.description: Retrieves multiple SEO URL records based on optional filter criteria such as keyword, key, value, store ID, and language ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByKeyValue
methods.description: Returns a nested array of SEO URLs grouped by store and language IDs for a given key and value.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByStoreId
methods.description: Retrieves all SEO URL records for a specific store.

methods.name: getSeoUrlsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all SEO URL records for a specific language.

methods.name: getTotalSeoUrls
methods.description: Returns the count of SEO URL records matching the optional filter criteria.
